## Notes

Page opening: one idea, one gradient phrase, one action, optional proof and art.

## Props (HeroProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `eyebrow` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` | The headline. A string lets `highlight` work. |
| `highlight` | `string` | The one phrase of the title that takes the brand gradient. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | The supporting sentence. |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` | One primary Button, optionally one secondary. |
| `art` | `React.ReactNode` | Second column. Defaults to the SignalPattern on an ink panel. |
| `proof` | `Array<{ value: React.ReactNode; label: string }>` | Up to three real numbers. |
| `layout` | `'split' \| 'center'` | @default "split" |
| `headingLevel` | `1 \| 2 \| 3` | @default 1 |

_Also accepts: Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, 'title'>._
